# Plan: automatic-release

Input: change.md, SOFTURE/skills `.github/workflows/release.yml` and README "Releasing". Complexity: small.

## Goal
A push to `master` whose `package.json` version is not released yet publishes it to npm and GitHub Packages and
creates the tag and the GitHub Release; npm auth works with `NPM_TOKEN` now and with trusted publishing later.

**Out of scope:** changelog tooling (release notes are generated by GitHub, as in SOFTURE/skills); automatic version
bumps from commit messages; changes to `ci.yml`.

## Approach
**Starting point:** `release.yml` ran on `v*.*.*` tags; npm publish used OIDC only, so the first version needed a
manual `npm publish`; tags were pushed by hand (`npm version` + `git push --follow-tags`).

**Chosen:** keep the SOFTURE/skills job layout (validate → npm → GitHub Packages → GitHub Release, every step
idempotent) and change the trigger to pushes to `master` plus a manual run from `master`. `validate` decides
whether the version is pending (missing on npm or missing GitHub Release). The npm job passes `NPM_TOKEN` as
`NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`; npm prefers OIDC when a trusted publisher exists, so the secret becomes a fallback.
`gh release create --target <sha>` creates the tag.
Rejected: keeping tag triggers - a tag is a manual step; release-please or changesets - more moving parts than
SOFTURE/skills uses and the owner asked for the same pipeline.

**Key decisions:**
| Decision | Choice | Why | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trigger | push to `master`, `workflow_dispatch` on `master` only | no manual tag; a release is a merged version bump | owner |
| Pending check | npm version missing or GitHub Release missing | re-runs fill in what is missing | plan |
| No token, package not on npm | warning, `published=false`, later jobs skipped, run stays green | merging this change before the secret exists must not fail master or create a tag | coordinator brief |
| Token present, trusted publisher configured | npm uses OIDC first | no workflow change when the owner switches | npm docs |
| Downstream gating | GitHub Packages and Release run only after npm published | the tag and the Release never point at a version missing on npm | plan |

## Phase 1: Workflow and docs
1. `.github/workflows/release.yml`: triggers, `validate.outputs.release`, token fallback, tag via `gh release create`.
2. README "Releasing": the new flow, `NPM_TOKEN` first, trusted publishing afterwards.
3. Roadmap: owner checklist lines for CMP-6.

**Tests:** `actionlint` on the workflow; CI on the pull request; the first push to master after merge must end green
with the "NPM_TOKEN is not set" warning and no tag.

## Risks and rollback
- npm may reject the token publish if the token lacks bypass 2FA: README names the token settings.
- Rollback: revert the commit; no registry state is created until the owner adds the secret.
